    • malformedGestureStateFailsDuringDecoding

      public static void malformedGestureStateFailsDuringDecoding(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Every mode round-trips through the gesture-state packet under its fixed wire id, and an unknown mode id or a missing modifier flag fails during decoding. No in-game reproduction applies: this guards the one client-to-server input and the stability of its wire ids, which a normal client cannot violate.

    • gestureStateTracksModeAndModifier

      public static void gestureStateTracksModeAndModifier(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      The server records the client's selected mode and current modifier state. To reproduce in-game: cycle to Bar mode, hold the modifier, and right-click an eligible item against a block. The server performs the Bar placement rather than another mode or an ordinary use.

    • interactionReadsOnlyTheMainHand

      public static void interactionReadsOnlyTheMainHand(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Stack gestures act only from the main hand. To reproduce in-game: leave the main hand empty, hold a depositable item in the off hand, hold the modifier, and right-click a stack. The off-hand item is not deposited. Modified empty-hand clicks and Toggle Permanent with an occupied hand retain ordinary use; plain extraction consumes even an empty target.

    • vanillaInteractionReachesDepositExtractAndPlacement

      public static void vanillaInteractionReachesDepositExtractAndPlacement(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)

    • extractionRefusesIncompatibleOrFullHands

      public static void extractionRefusesIncompatibleOrFullHands(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Extraction refuses an incompatible held item, the same item with different data components, or a compatible stack with no room, and a compatible partial stack takes only what fits. To reproduce in-game: store 8 stone, then plain-click it while holding dirt, while holding renamed stone, and while holding a full stack of plain stone; the Storage contents and held stacks remain unchanged. Then plain-click it holding 60 plain stone: the hand reaches 64 and 4 stone stay stored, so none were taken out only to be dropped.

    • rotationSoundThrottleSuppressesSameTickAndClears

      public static void rotationSoundThrottleSuppressesSameTickAndClears(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Rotation sound pacing permits one sound per player within its throttle window and resets when player state clears. To reproduce in-game: perform rotation gestures faster than the throttle interval, disconnect and reconnect, then rotate immediately. Rapid repeats are suppressed; the reconnect clears the old player's pacing state so the first new rotation can sound.

    • playerPlacementAwardsCriterionAfterDeposit

      public static void playerPlacementAwardsCriterionAfterDeposit(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game with the test mod: revoke somestacks:gametest_place_storage, hold exactly two Dirt, and create a Storage Stack. Its placed-block criterion is awarded using the original two-item offer even though the deposit empties the hand. A blocked destination awards nothing. Revoke it again and deposit two Dirt into a full pile: growth awards nothing.

    • disabledTypesRefuseNewBlocksButKeepExistingOnes

      public static void disabledTypesRefuseNewBlocksButKeepExistingOnes(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity,GameTestScaffold.Automation> automation)
      A type the server has disabled starts no new block and never grows, while blocks of it that already exist keep taking deposits and giving them back. To reproduce in-game: build an empty Storage, Singles, and Bar Stack and fill two more of each completely; set every enable_*_stack_block option to false and run /ss reload. Selecting each type and modifier-clicking the top of a stone block places nothing, keeps the held items, and the action bar says that type's placement is disabled. Modifier-clicking the top of the empty block deposits one item and a plain click takes it back. Modifier-clicking the top of a full block, or a hopper feeding the other full block, adds no block above it. Set the options back to true and reload: the stone click places a block of the type, the modifier-click grows the first full block, and the hopper grows the second.

    • maximumHeightRefusesGrowthAndHidesHeadroom

      public static void maximumHeightRefusesGrowthAndHidesHeadroom(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity,GameTestScaffold.Automation> automation)
      At the configured maximum height a full run takes nothing more and offers automation no headroom, while one more block of allowed height lets automation grow it. To reproduce in-game: set max_pile_height to 1, run /ss reload, and fill a one-block Storage, Singles, and Bar Stack. A hopper feeding each adds nothing, a modifier-click on its top adds no block above, and the action bar says the stack is at its maximum height. With 2 and a full two-block run of each, the same holds. Raising the limit by one lets the hopper grow each run by one block.

    • deniedItemsRefuseDepositsAndOnlyModDenialStopsAutomation

      public static void deniedItemsRefuseDepositsAndOnlyModDenialStopsAutomation(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity,GameTestScaffold.Automation> automation)
      An item on disable_items is refused from players only, while a namespace on disable_mods is refused from players and automation, and neither stops a player taking stored contents out. To reproduce in-game: add minecraft:dirt to disable_items and run /ss reload. Modifier-clicking a Storage Stack holding dirt, or the top of a stone block, deposits and places nothing, keeps the dirt, and the action bar says dirt is disabled; stone still deposits, and a hopper still feeds dirt in. Replace the entry with minecraft on disable_mods and reload: the dirt click is refused with a message naming the mod, the hopper stops, and a plain click still takes stone out. Clear both lists and reload: the dirt deposits.

    • blockUseDenialFreezesStackGestures

      public static void blockUseDenialFreezesStackGestures(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, InteractionChecks.BlockUseDenial denial)
      A loader's block-use denial, and Spectator mode, stop every gesture on an existing stack; with neither, every gesture applies. To reproduce in-game: inside a claim that denies you block use, modifier-click a Storage Stack holding dirt, plain-click it empty-handed, toggle its permanence in Toggle Permanent mode, Shift-right-click it with a redstone torch, and Shift-right-click a stored Singles item with a soul torch. Nothing changes and you keep the dirt. Repeat in Spectator mode outside the claim: nothing changes. In Survival outside the claim, the dirt goes in, the plain click takes stone out, the pile becomes permanent, the block turns, and the item turns.

    • fullMaxHeightDepositExplainsRefusal

      public static void fullMaxHeightDepositExplainsRefusal(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A deposit into a full Storage pile that cannot grow because it is at the configured height is refused with a message. To reproduce in-game: set max_pile_height = 1, run /ss reload, fill a one-block Storage pile, and modifier-click it with another item. Nothing moves and the action bar says the stack is at its maximum height. After taking one stack out, the same click deposits.

    • adventurePlacementAndGrowthShareTheBuildCheck

      public static void adventurePlacementAndGrowthShareTheBuildCheck(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      In Adventure mode, placing a stack and growing a Storage pile answer to the same build check. To reproduce in-game: in Adventure mode, select Storage and modifier-click the top of a stone block holding plain dirt: nothing is placed. Hold dirt whose can_place_on names stone and Storage Stack, and the same click places a Storage Stack holding it. Fill that stack with full stacks of stone and modifier-click it holding plain dirt: it does not grow. Holding the can_place_on dirt, the same click grows a block above holding that dirt.

    • use

      public static boolean use(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit)
      Runs vanilla's server block use with the main hand, the path a player's right-click on a block takes: Forge and NeoForge post RightClickBlock and Fabric invokes UseBlockCallback first, then the clicked block's own use runs unless a listener stopped it. Returns whether the click was consumed.
